name: claudetto
description: Adds a lean output style, a main agent with a roster of six agents, and a permission gate that answers each permission prompt. Adds a status line command with the plan usage, and the `setup` skill. Adds the MiniSpec skills `propose`, `apply`, `verify`, `archive`, `explore`, `update`, and `sync`. Adds a handover to a fresh session in place of the compaction summary, and a `goal` check. Adds a check of each ticked task, a ledger of edited files, and a cleanup at session start. With a key, Jev answers `AskUserQuestion`, the asks of the gate, and the handover offer. A Haiku 5.5 classifier settles each ask of the gate that Jev does not settle.

decide.title: Second Opinion
decide.description: Use `off` for no pick, or `jev` for Jev (it needs `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, and the questions go to the TypeSafe API). With `jev` and the key, Jev answers each `AskUserQuestion` call and the dialog does not show, unless Jev is not sure about a question. Jev also gets each ask of the permission gate, with the call and the newest 3 requests of the user.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: Use `haiku` to let Haiku 5.5 settle each ask of the permission gate that Jev is not sure about: it allows a routine call or a call that the user asked for, and blocks the rest with a reason. A failure goes to the dialog. Use `off` to send each such ask to the dialog.

compaction.title: Compaction
compaction.description: Use `auto` to pick a handover or a compaction for each case from the table, `handover` to hand over at each trigger, `built-in` for the compaction of Claude Code, or `code` for a compaction that code builds with no model request.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: The plan tier of the login, such as `default_claude_max_20x`. `claudetto-setup` writes it from `~/.claude.json`. Keep it empty for an API key or an unknown tier.

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.title: TypeSafe API Key
TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: The key of Jev for the `decide` option. Claude Code keeps it in secure storage, not in a settings file.
